reporting-org.narrative: Harvard Global Research and Support Services, Inc.

title.narrative: J-PAL LAI Pilot : Engaging Parents for Students’ Career and Academic Success

description.narrative: The project aims to identify effective and culturally appropriate ways to increase parental support for girls pursuing high-income and STEM careers in Uzbekistan. It will test which types of information and trusted messengers are most effective at changing parental attitudes, addressing concerns about financial returns, work-life balance, and marriage prospects. Ultimately, the research seeks to develop a scalable approach to reducing gender gaps in education and employment by addressing the social norms and parental beliefs that influence girls’ career choices.
